full_library_validation: Exact recomputed sum across all 45768 source exon-count features for every selected cell equals data/total_exon_counts
sparse_orientation_validation: Independent candidate alignment in both CSC orientations for ten deterministically selected cells
normalization: log1p(exon read counts / full exon library * 1e6), per-cell logCPM; read counts, not UMI or TPM
animal_inference: withheld; library batch and donor sampling reviewed descriptively
